Container.Name: velociraptor
Container.Overview:
Velociraptor DFIR server running in Docker, adapted for Unraid.
This template is based on the supplied docker-compose.yml and server.config.yaml.
Mapped services: - Frontend / client ingress: 8000/tcp - API / gRPC gateway: 8001/tcp - Web GUI: 8889/tcp
Persistent paths: - /mnt/user/appdata/velociraptor -> /velociraptor - /mnt/user/appdata/velociraptor/logs -> /var/logs
Important setup notes: - Put your server.config.yaml into /mnt/user/appdata/velociraptor/server.config.yaml before first start. - The supplied server.config.yaml binds Frontend, API and GUI to 0.0.0.0, which is compatible with bridge networking and Unraid port publishing. - The supplied server.config.yaml uses Logging.output_directory: ./logs, so logs are persisted under /mnt/user/appdata/velociraptor/logs. - The GUI uses TLS/self-signed or configured certificates. Browser certificate warnings can be expected unless a trusted certificate is configured. - Keep API port 8001 restricted to trusted networks only.
If you want to keep the custom Docker network from the compose file, create the network on Unraid first and then switch the container network manually from bridge to the custom network in the Unraid Docker UI.
Troubleshooting: docker logs -f velociraptor docker exec -it velociraptor sh
Source: https://github.com/weslambert/velociraptor-docker
